headline: US 30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rates Climb to 7.28% After Four-Week Decline
summary: Average US 30-year mortgage rates climbed to 7.28%, snapping a four-week decline as government bond yields rebounded on persistent domestic inflation concerns.
why: Mortgage rates track long-term Treasury yields and directly govern housing affordability and residential mortgage origination volumes.

impacts.name: US 30-Year Mortgage Rate
impacts.why: Rising Treasury yields pushed benchmark 30-year home borrowing costs up to 7.28%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
